WITH min_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013_consumption
    FROM v_yearmonth
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK' AND Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
min_customers_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_2013_consumption) AS min_total_consumption
    FROM min_consumption_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT 
        mcs.Segment,
        SUM(mcs.total_2013_consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT mcs.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM min_consumption_customers mcs
    JOIN min_customers_per_segment mcp ON mcs.Segment = mcp.Segment AND mcs.total_2013_consumption = mcp.min_total_consumption
    GROUP BY mcs.Segment
)
SELECT 
    avg_consumption AS annual_average,
    Segment
FROM averages
ORDER BY Segment
